name: coder-delegation
description: Multi-role AI coding collaboration plugin. A strong-model Architect reuses a technical plan + execution plan produced by superpowers (brainstorming + writing-plans), machine-readizes them into a self-contained Coder task doc with mandatory verification closed-loop (PRD↔code mapping, cross-repo call chain, field pass-through, framework API project-usage confirmation); a weak-model Coder executes the doc mechanically with four-way comparison (PRD+tech-design+task-doc+code). Large codebase scans are delegated to weak models (summary) to cut strong-model token cost. Architect reviews with optional bridge to multi-reviewer for blind audit. The Architect does NOT design solutions (that is superpowers' job) and does NOT code; the Coder does NOT design. v1.0.0 details: see docs/changelog.md.
